checkpoint.title: From anywhere outdoors: a shiny Drowzee in Route 11's grass by the wild RNG, stored in the PC, back to the nurse

events.why: Fly to Vermilion City, Route 11's Center.
Into Route 11's west grass, where Sweet Scent finds Ekans, Spearow and Drowzee.
The wild RNG's hard reset boots from this save, in the grass.

A shiny Drowzee, the soonest of the table for TID 33002 and SID 9011 (read once from the save's memory). seed_shift 4: what this checkpoint's grass save (the save file's save number 141) adds to the table's seeds on mGBA, measured from it. The party's last member knows Sweet Scent. ingame_offset -3: the target's waits otherwise land on another advance, measured by replaying the presses on the grass save with an RNG trace.
Stores the catch, so the party is five again with the Sweet Scent member last, as the next catch needs.
Sweet Scent's PP back at the nurse.
Outdoors, where the next catch starts.

metadata.notes: mGBA only. The seed shift holds for this checkpoint's start save as the program's chain leaves it (from sevii_story's end, two saves a catch): a start save with another number of saves before it boots a few timer counts off and misses, failing the checkpoint (wild_rng_not_shiny) with the catch unsaved.
